items.title: Once Poisoned, Arbitrarily Controlled: A Programmable Backdoor in VLMs
items.summary: Existing vision-language model (VLM) backdoors are usually treated as static vulnerabilities: one-to-one and N-to-N attacks bind one or more triggers to a finite set of targets before victim training. This assumption substantially underestimates the threat. We show that a single poisoning phase can implant a programmable backdoor into a VLM, allowing an attacker to choose previously unseen target-caption semantics at inference time and synthesize corresponding stealthy triggers on demand. Unlike fixed-mapping attacks, the proposed any-to-any caption-control paradigm decouples post-training target selection from poisoning, enabling dynamic control of target captions without retraining the VLM. Our method has two components. First, a heuristic poisoning strategy exposes the model to diverse trigger-caption pairs, encouraging it to learn a general trigger-as-instruction rule rather than memorize a specific backdoor pattern. Second, a feature-space trigger steganography method maps any attacker-specified target caption to a stealthy visual trigger, implemented as either a norm-controlled perturbation or a non-semantic patch. Once inserted into arbitrary images, these triggers cause the poisoned VLM to generate outputs semantically aligned with the chosen target caption, even when the target was unseen during poisoning. Extensive experiments show that our attack achieves high any-to-any caption-control success rates, preserves clean model utility, and remains effective under several classical backdoor defenses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文揭示了一个针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的新型后门攻击范式。传统VLM后门被视为静态漏洞，通常将有限数量的触发器映射到固定目标（一对一或N对N），且必须在训练前确定映射关系。作者认为这严重低估了威胁，并提出一种'可编程后门'：单次投毒阶段即可在VLM中植入一个可编程后门，使得攻击者在推理时能动态选择此前未见过的目标描述（caption）语义，并按需生成相应的隐蔽触发器。与固定映射攻击不同，这种'任意到任意'（any-to-any）的标题控制范式将训练后的目标选择与投毒阶段解耦，无需重新训练模型即可动态控制目标标题。方法包含两个组件：1）启发式投毒策略，使模型接触到多样的触发器-描述对，鼓励其学习'触发器即指令'的通用规则，而非记忆特定后门模式；2）特征空间触发器隐写方法，将攻击者指定的任意目标标题映射到隐蔽视觉触发器，实现为范数受控的扰动或非语义补丁。一旦将触发器插入任意图像，中毒VLM就会生成与所选目标标题语义对齐的输出，即使该目标在投毒时未出现过。大量实验表明，该方法实现了较高的any-to-any标题控制成功率，同时保持干净数据上的模型效用，并能规避若干经典后门防御。此研究对VLM安全评估和防御具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究颠覆了传统后门攻击需固定映射的假设，展示单次投毒即可实现运行时任意目标控制，使VLM后门威胁从静态升级为动态可编程。对依赖VLM的下游应用构成潜在风险，安全从业者需重新评估模型供应链中的投毒防御策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该攻击可影响部署VLM进行图像理解、描述生成的场景，下游系统可能遭受定向内容篡改。具体在野影响尚未明确。
defense_advice_zh: 需研发针对可编程后门的新型防御机制，经典防御已被证明有效性有限

items.title: @cedar-policy/authorization-for-expressjs is an open-source Express.js middleware that integrates Cedar authorization into Express applications by mapping HTTP requests to Cedar...
items.summary: @cedar-policy/authorization-for-expressjs is an open-source Express.js middleware that integrates Cedar authorization into Express applications by mapping HTTP requests to Cedar actions and evaluating authorization policies before allowing requests to proceed. Versions prior to 0.3.0 have an issue where, under certain circumstances, the middleware matches incoming requests against Cedar action mappings using req.originalUrl, which includes the query string, while Express routes requests using only the path component. The middleware uses req.originalUrl to match incoming requests against Cedar action mappings. In Express, req.originalUrl includes the query string, while route matching uses only the path. This creates a divergence between what Cedar authorizes and what Express executes. When an application defines separate actions for overlapping path prefixes with different authorization requirements (for example, GET /users for listing all users with admin-only access, and GET /users/{id} for retrieving a single user with any authenticated user access), an actor can append a query string to bypass the more restrictive policy. Sending GET /users/?x=1 causes the middleware to match against /users/{id} (with id parameter set to ?x=1) and evaluate the less restrictive action, while Express routes the request to the /users list handler. This allows inappropriate access to the more restrictive endpoint. This issue has been addressed in version 0.30. Some workarounds are available. Validate and sanitize incoming request paths before they reach the authorization middleware. Ensure that applications do not rely solely on the middleware for authorization when defining multiple actions on overlapping path prefixes with different permission levels.

llm_summary.summary_zh: @cedar-policy/authorization-for-expressjs 是一个用于 Express.js 的开源中间件，它将 Cedar 授权策略集成到应用中，通过在请求处理前将 HTTP 请求映射为 Cedar 动作并评估策略来控制访问。在 0.3.0 之前的版本中，存在一个授权绕过漏洞，根因在于中间件使用 req.originalUrl（包含查询字符串）匹配请求与 Cedar 动作映射，而 Express 路由匹配只使用路径部分，导致授权决策与实际执行路由之间出现偏差。这种偏差在应用为重叠路径前缀定义了不同权限等级的动作时被利用。例如，若 GET /users 要求管理员权限，而 GET /users/{id} 仅要求任何已认证用户权限，攻击者可以构造 GET /users/?x=1 的请求。中间件会将此请求匹配到 /users/{id} 动作（id 参数视为 '?x=1'），从而评估宽松策略；但 Express 实际将该请求路由到 /users 列表处理器，导致攻击者绕过管理员限制访问用户列表。该漏洞可能导致未授权访问敏感数据或执行未授权操作，影响机密性和完整性，并可能造成权限提升。目前已发布修复版本 0.30。建议用户立即升级，若无法升级则需在授权中间件之前对请求路径进行严格验证和清理，并审查路由设计以避免对重叠路径的依赖。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可被低权限用户通过构造特殊 URL 绕过授权策略，访问本应受高权限保护的数据或功能，造成敏感信息泄露或未授权操作，在 CVSS 中评分为 8.8（高危）。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用路径匹配不一致，在特定路由配置下访问更严格的端点，导致未授权读取或修改数据，可能破坏系统完整性，并可能进一步提升权限。

items.title: sigstore-java is a sigstore java client for interacting with sigstore infrastructure. Version 2.0.0 erroneously removed verification of the integrated (Rekor entry) time) agains...
items.summary: sigstore-java is a sigstore java client for interacting with sigstore infrastructure. Version 2.0.0 erroneously removed verification of the integrated (Rekor entry) time) against the Fulcio certificate. Version 2.1.0 re-added this verification with enhancements that adhere to the Sigstore verification spec. The old sigstore-conformance test for this check was built incorrectly. This vulnerability impacts only users verifying bundles with `dev.sigstore:sigstore-java:2.0.0`. Older versions are not affected; it is fixed in `dev.sigstore:sigstore-java:2.1.0` A malicious actor may exploit this if they were able to access a users system and exfiltrate the temporary private key used during signing and then reuse an old fulcio certificate later without requiring direct access to the user's credentials. Users may protect themselves by re-verifying their artifacts using the newest sigstore-java or another current sigstore client. Transparency logs may also be audited for unauthorized signatures for a suspected reused identity.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-48791 是 sigstore-java 项目（用于与 sigstore 基础设施交互的 Java 客户端库）的一个安全漏洞。在版本 2.0.0 中，开发者错误地移除了对集成时间（Rekor 条目时间）与 Fulcio 证书的验证逻辑。该验证在 2.1.0 版本中重新添加，并按照 sigstore 验证规范进行了增强。旧版的 sigstore-conformance 测试对这一检查的构建是错误的，导致未能发现该问题。该漏洞仅影响使用 `dev.sigstore:sigstore-java:2.0.0` 进行 bundle 验证的用户，其他版本不受影响，并在 2.1.0 中修复。攻击者需要在能够访问用户系统并窃取签名过程中使用的临时私钥的前提下，才能利用此漏洞，之后可以复用旧的 Fulcio 证书而不需要直接访问用户的长期凭证。CVSS 评分为 2.0（低危），攻击复杂度低，但需要本地访问权限和高权限，且用户交互（UI:R）。目前该漏洞未被列入已知利用漏洞目录，也未标注在野利用。建议用户升级到 2.1.0 或使用其他当前版本的 sigstore 客户端重新验证制品，同时可以审计透明度日志以发现可疑的签名重用。防护措施包括及时升级库版本，并限制系统本地访问权限。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: sigstore 供应链信任机制核心组件；版本 2.0.0 误删验证导致签名可被时间混淆，破坏完整性保证。高危供应链库，修复版本已发布。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 在本地攻击场景下，能窃取临时私钥的恶意行为者可复用旧证书伪造未授权签名，绕过时间验证，但攻击前提苛刻。

items.title: The Meeting Room Booking System (MRBS) is a PHP-based application for booking meeting rooms. Prior to version 1.12.2, an unauthenticated request can be made to redirect the user...
items.summary: The Meeting Room Booking System (MRBS) is a PHP-based application for booking meeting rooms. Prior to version 1.12.2, an unauthenticated request can be made to redirect the user to a query-specified location. This allows an attacker to create a specially-crafted URL to an MRBS installation that will cause the user who clicks it to be redirected to the attacker-specified redirect URL, which could be a spoofed MRBS login page, for example. Version 1.12.2 contains a fix. No known workarounds are available.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞是一个典型的开放重定向（Open Redirect）问题，影响 MRBS 会议房间预订系统 1.12.2 之前的版本。由于程序未对重定向目标 URL 进行充分校验，未认证的恶意请求可以构造包含恶意重定向地址的链接。当用户点击该链接时，浏览器会从合法的 MRBS 站点跳转到攻击者指定的外部站点，例如一个仿冒的登录页面，从而诱导用户输入凭据，造成敏感信息泄露或进一步钓鱼攻击。攻击者无需认证即可利用，且无需任何特权或用户交互以外的条件（用户点击链接）。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分暂无，但开放重定向本身通常被认为低至中等风险。官方已在 1.12.2 版本中修复，没有可用的临时解决方案。建议管理员尽快升级到最新版本，同时可在网络边界限制对 MRBS 的访问，以降低被利用的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该开放重定向漏洞可被用于钓鱼攻击，借助合法 MRBS 域名增强可信度，诱导用户泄露凭据。虽然不直接导致代码执行，但在企业环境中可能引发账号接管或进一步渗透。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可构造恶意链接，将用户从正常 MRBS 站点重定向至仿冒登录页，导致凭据窃取和钓鱼风险；暂无证据表明存在在野利用。

items.title: In OpenStack Designate before 22.0.2, the mDNS handler performs pool-blind lookups when resolving record queries and NOTIFY requests. When two zones with the same name exist acr...
items.summary: In OpenStack Designate before 22.0.2, the mDNS handler performs pool-blind lookups when resolving record queries and NOTIFY requests. When two zones with the same name exist across different pools, the lookup fails with a deterministic error, causing the handler to return REFUSED for all DNS queries through that path. The _handle_notify path is exploitable via a single unauthenticated UDP packet. This is independently reachable through the cross-tenant zone overlap described in a different recent CVE, and also affects legitimate same-tenant cross-pool configurations. BIND9 views do not mitigate this issue as mDNS is a shared service upstream of any view configuration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: OpenStack Designate 在 22.0.2 之前的版本中存在一个影响 mDNS 处理器的安全缺陷。该缺陷源于处理器在解析记录查询和 NOTIFY 请求时执行了不区分池（pool-blind）的查找操作。当不同池中存在两个同名区域时，查找会以确定性的错误失败，导致该路径上的所有 DNS 查询返回 REFUSED 响应。攻击者可以利用 _handle_notify 路径，通过单个未经认证的 UDP 数据包触发此问题，造成拒绝服务（DoS）。此漏洞既可被独立利用，也可通过另一个近期 CVE 所描述的跨租户区域重叠场景访问，同时也会影响合法的同租户跨池配置。值得注意的是，BIND9 的视图机制并不能缓解此问题，因为 mDNS 是任何视图配置上游的共享服务。CVSS 评分为 6.8，属于中危漏洞。建议升级到 22.0.2 或更高版本，并限制对 mDNS 服务的网络暴露，以降低攻击面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许未经认证的远程攻击者通过单个 UDP 包触发 DNS 服务拒绝服务，且 mDNS 共享服务特性使 BIND9 视图无法防护，影响跨池及跨租户场景，需及时修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用构造的 UDP NOTIFY 请求，导致 mDNS 处理器对所有相关 DNS 查询返回 REFUSED，造成 DNS 解析服务不可用，尤其影响多池或跨租户配置下的 OpenStack Designate 环境。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许未经认证的远程攻击者通过单个 UDP 包触发 DNS 服务拒绝服务，且 mDNS 共享服务特性使 BIND9 视图无法防护，影响跨池及跨租户场景，需及时修复。

items.title: FUXA is a web-based Process Visualization (SCADA/HMI/Dashboard) software. When `secureEnabled=true`, FUXA `1.3.0-2773` still allows guest and invalid-token requests to read proj...
items.summary: FUXA is a web-based Process Visualization (SCADA/HMI/Dashboard) software. When `secureEnabled=true`, FUXA `1.3.0-2773` still allows guest and invalid-token requests to read project, alarms, and scheduler APIs. Version 1.3.1 fixes this issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: FUXA 是一个基于 Web 的流程可视化（SCADA/HMI/Dashboard）软件，广泛应用于工业控制系统的监控和管理。本漏洞存在于 FUXA 1.3.0-2773 版本中，当配置项 secureEnabled 设置为 true（即启用安全模式）时，系统仍然允许 guest 用户和携带无效令牌（invalid-token）的请求访问项目（project）、报警（alarms）和调度器（scheduler）相关的 API 接口。这意味着攻击者无需有效凭据即可读取这些敏感资源，导致认证机制被绕过，属于访问控制缺陷。具体影响包括：未授权获取 SCADA 项目的配置信息、报警阈值、调度计划等，这些数据可能包含网络拓扑、设备参数、操作策略等关键情报，为后续针对性攻击提供便利。此外，由于 guest 访问可能被默认启用，实际利用门槛较低。该问题在 FUXA 1.3.1 版本中已修复。建议所有使用受影响版本的用户立即升级至 1.3.1 或更高版本，并在升级完成前限制对 FUXA Web 服务的网络访问，仅允许可信主机连接，同时审查现有访问日志确认是否存在异常请求。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SCADA 系统是工业控制的核心，认证绕过可导致敏感信息泄露，攻击者借此可深入了解生产环境，增加定向攻击风险，且工业环境通常更难快速修补。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 未授权访问项目、报警和调度 API，导致敏感配置和数据泄露，可能暴露网络架构、设备凭据和运行参数，破坏系统保密性，并为后续攻击提供侦察基础。

items.summary:
The web
interface of the affected
device relies on the HTTP referrer header as part of
request validation.  Requests containing empty Referer value, or omitting

Successful exploitation may allow an adjacent attacker with access to the web management

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-15141 是一个影响某设备 Web 管理界面的请求验证缺陷。该设备的 Web 接口在验证请求时依赖 HTTP Referer 头作为安全机制的一部分，但由于验证逻辑存在不足，当请求中 Referer 头为空或完全缺失时，请求仍可能被接受并处理。攻击者只需位于相邻网络，且能够访问该设备的 Web 管理界面，就可以利用此缺陷获取设备配置详情及其他敏感信息。此漏洞的根因在于对 Referer 头的信任过度，未充分验证其存在性或合法性。目前没有 CVSS 评分、EPSS 数据，也未被列入已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目录，且没有明确证据表明已在野利用。受影响产品及厂商信息未提供，因此无法确定具体的修复补丁或受影响的版本范围。综合来看，该漏洞属于 Web 应用逻辑缺陷，实际利用需要满足网络相邻且可访问管理界面的条件，但信息泄露风险仍需重视。建议关注厂商安全公告，若设备暴露在不可信网络，应限制管理接口的访问来源，并在可能的情况下更新固件或软件。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致敏感设备配置信息泄露。虽然利用需相邻网络且能访问管理界面，但管理接口常是攻击者的重点目标，且 Referer 验证缺陷容易被忽视，风险不可低估。

items.title: etcd is a distributed key-value store for the data of a distributed system. Prior to versions 3.5.33, 3.6.14, and 3.7.1, a network attacker who can reach an etcd TLS listener ca...
items.summary: etcd is a distributed key-value store for the data of a distributed system. Prior to versions 3.5.33, 3.6.14, and 3.7.1, a network attacker who can reach an etcd TLS listener can open many TCP connections and never send a ClientHello. In client/pkg/transport/listener_tls.go, each connection handled by tlsListener.acceptLoop spawns a goroutine that blocks indefinitely inside tls.Conn.Handshake() and remains tracked in the pending map. Unbounded goroutine and map growth can exhaust memory in the etcd process, causing loss of availability for the cluster and, when etcd backs Kubernetes, the control plane. This issue is fixed in versions 3.5.33, 3.6.14, and 3.7.1.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-73500 是 etcd 分布式键值存储中的一个拒绝服务（DoS）漏洞。etcd 常被用作 Kubernetes 控制平面的后端存储，因此该漏洞可能导致关键基础设施的可用性丧失。攻击者只需能够访问 etcd 的 TLS 监听端口（例如 2379/2380），无需任何认证，即可发送大量 TCP 连接但从不发送 ClientHello 消息，从而触发漏洞。在 etcd 的 client/pkg/transport/listener_tls.go 中，每个新连接都会由 acceptLoop 创建一个 goroutine，并在 tls.Conn.Handshake() 上无限期阻塞；这些 goroutine 和与之关联的 pending map 条目会无限增长，最终耗尽进程内存。这会造成 etcd 进程崩溃或失去响应，使整个分布式系统的数据操作失败。若 etcd 为 Kubernetes 提供服务，则会导致 API Server 无法读写数据，控制平面完全中断。修复版本为 3.5.33、3.6.14 和 3.7.1。建议立即升级；若无法升级，应限制对 TLS 端口的网络暴露，仅允许可信客户端，并监控异常连接数量。当前仅有元数据，无证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无需认证即可远程发起，利用简单，极易耗尽内存，导致 etcd 及依赖它的 Kubernetes 控制平面不可用，影响重大。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 导致 etcd 进程内存耗尽、崩溃或失去响应，集群可用性丧失；若 etcd 作为 Kubernetes 后端，将中断整个控制平面，所有集群管理操作失败。

items.why_it_matters: 无需认证即可远程发起，利用简单，极易耗尽内存，导致 etcd 及依赖它的 Kubernetes 控制平面不可用，影响重大。

items.title: etcd is a distributed key-value store for the data of a distributed system. Prior to versions 3.5.33, 3.6.14, and 3.7.1, a user granted READ permission on a single exact key can...
items.summary: etcd is a distributed key-value store for the data of a distributed system. Prior to versions 3.5.33, 3.6.14, and 3.7.1, a user granted READ permission on a single exact key can use the Watch gRPC API with clientv3.WithFromKey() to receive watch events for every key lexicographically greater than or equal to the permitted key. In server/etcdserver/api/v3rpc/watch.go, the open-ended RangeEnd sentinel is rewritten before the RBAC permission check in server/auth/range_perm_cache.go function isRangeOpPermitted, causing the request to be treated as an exact-key watch. Range/Get and DeleteRange requests are not affected, and the issue affects only clusters with authentication enabled. This issue is fixed in versions 3.5.33, 3.6.14, and 3.7.1.

llm_summary.summary_zh: etcd 是一个分布式键值存储系统，用于保存分布式系统数据。在版本 3.5.33、3.6.14 和 3.7.1 之前，存在一个权限绕过漏洞。当集群启用了认证后，一个仅被授予某个精确键 READ 权限的用户，可以利用 Watch gRPC API 并结合 clientv3.WithFromKey() 选项，接收到所有字典序大于或等于该键的键的 watch 事件。漏洞根源在于 server/etcdserver/api/v3rpc/watch.go 中，开放范围的 RangeEnd 哨兵在 RBAC 权限检查（位于 server/auth/range_perm_cache.go 的 isRangeOpPermitted 函数）之前被重写，导致请求被错误地视为精确键 watch，从而绕过了原本应有的范围权限校验。值得注意的是，Range/Get 和 DeleteRange 请求不受此问题影响，攻击面仅限于 Watch API。该漏洞仅影响启用了认证的 etcd 集群。修复版本为 3.5.33、3.6.14 和 3.7.1。建议所有受影响用户尽快升级到上述修复版本，同时在条件允许的情况下限制 etcd 端口的网络暴露范围，以降低被利用的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞使低权限用户可越权通过 Watch 监听大量键值变化，导致敏感数据泄露。启用认证的 etcd 集群均受影响，修复版本已发布，应优先升级。

items.title: Governing the KV Cache: Preventing Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Multi-Tenant LLM Inference
items.summary: The key-value (KV) cache is the primary throughput optimization in modern large language model (LLM) inference, enabling prefix reuse across requests. In multi-tenant deployments this cache is shared across tenants, creating a timing side channel: an adversarial tenant can reconstruct another tenant's private prompt by probing cache-hit latency. Three published attacks exploit it -- PROMPTPEEK, EarlyBird and InputSnatch -- reaching up to 100% attack success rate against unprotected vLLM and SGLang, with rates varying by cache architecture and prompt structure. We present KVGov, a governance layer addressing all three attack families' prefix-cache paths under one mechanism. A per-principal salt sigma_p = HMAC_K(secret, principal_id) seeds the block-hash chain, making cache keys cryptographically disjoint across principals. An ablation (N=1000 trials, seed 2026, deterministic judges) isolates this salt as the necessary and sufficient component. KVGov adds ORIGAMI, a Stackelberg water-filling audit scheduler that reduces adversary expected utility by 12.6% at realistic tenant heterogeneity (Gini 0.63), and an evolutionary stability analysis giving a 31.6% adversary-prevalence tipping point below which global caching remains stable. On real hardware (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, vLLM 0.26.0, NVIDIA A100) we measure a gate-verified cold/cached TTFT ratio of 0.22, confirming the channel is exploitable at production scale; the defense itself is evaluated in simulation calibrated to those measurements. We replicate the channel on an independent stack (llama.cpp on Apple Metal, ratio 0.093). Finally, isolation and cache efficiency need not conflict: identifying information resides only where prompts diverge, so injecting the salt at that boundary rather than the chain root retains an estimated 93% of the prefix-cache benefit with no cross-principal signal.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究多租户大语言模型（LLM）推理场景中 KV 缓存引发的时序侧信道泄露问题。KV 缓存是现代 LLM 推理的关键吞吐优化手段，通过跨请求复用前缀来加速生成；但在多租户部署中，该缓存被多个租户共享，攻击者可以利用缓存命中延迟差异，重建其他租户的私有提示词。已有三种攻击（PROMPTPEEK、EarlyBird、InputSnatch）利用了这一通道，在未防护的 vLLM 和 SGLang 上最高可达 100% 的攻击成功率，具体成功率取决于缓存架构和提示词结构。作者提出 KVGov，一个统一的治理层，专门应对这三类攻击的前缀缓存路径。其核心机制是为每个主体（租户）引入独立的盐值 sigma_p = HMAC_K(secret, principal_id)，并以此作为块哈希链的种子，使不同主体之间的缓存键在密码学意义上互不相交。消融实验（N=1000 次试验，固定随机种子，确定性评估）证明该盐值是阻断攻击的必要且充分条件。KVGov 还包含 ORIGAMI，一种基于 Stackelberg 博弈的水填充审计调度器，在现实租户异质性（基尼系数 0.63）下将攻击者的期望效用降低 12.6%；演化稳定性分析给出 31.6% 的攻击者流行度临界点，低于该阈值时全局缓存保持稳定。在真实硬件（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、vLLM 0.26.0、NVIDIA A100）上，作者测量得到经过门控验证的冷/热 TTFT 比例为 0.22，确认了生产规模下该通道的可利用性；防御效果在与测量校准的模拟环境中评估。作者还在独立技术栈（Apple Metal 上的 llama.cpp）复现了该通道，比例为 0.093。最后，文章指出隔离与缓存效率并不必然冲突：识别信息只存在于提示词分叉处，因此在分叉边界注入盐值而非在链根处注入，可以在不产生跨主体信号的前提下保留约 93% 的前缀缓存收益。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了多租户 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存共享带来的严重隐私泄露风险，并给出了可落地的防御机制，对使用 vLLM/SGLang 等推理框架的云服务商和模型托管方具有直接参考价值，有助于在设计阶段规避时序侧信道。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用共享 KV 缓存的多租户 LLM 推理服务，尤其是通过前缀复用优化吞吐的框架；攻击可导致租户私有提示词泄露，影响范围涵盖提示词中的敏感信息。防御方案可迁移至任何基于前缀缓存的推理系统。
detection_signals_zh: 监控跨租户缓存命中率的异常分布
检测针对同一前缀的重复请求模式
记录请求延迟的统计特征，识别超出正常范围的时序波动
defense_advice_zh: 采用 per-principal 的缓存密钥隔离，如 HMAC 盐值
在提示词分叉处而非根处注入隔离标识以保留缓存收益
部署基于博弈论的审计调度器限制攻击者收益
对缓存命中/未命中的时序响应加入噪声或门控
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents integrated with external tools are vulnerable to indirect prompt injections embedded in environmental states. However, existing studies largely rely on manually implemented or reused environments, stochastic LLM-based tool simulation, and predefined injection locations, limiting scalable security research across broader domains. To bridge this gap, we propose **ToolHazard**, a scalable adversarial environment synthesis framework that reduces human engineering and supports expansion with additional seed domains and compute. Through an Environment Simulator, an Attacker Agent, and a User Simulator, ToolHazard synthesizes executable stateful environments, discovers viable injection points and generates environment-specific payloads, and constructs state-grounded long-horizon tasks. Based on ToolHazard, we build **ToolHazard-Bench** for stress-testing agents under complex workflows and diverse environmental attacks. Experiments reveal substantial agent vulnerabilities and show that injection timing and placement affect attack effectiveness. Moreover, ToolHazard-generated alignment data improves security on both ToolHazard-Bench and AgentDojo while preserving benign task utility.

llm_summary.summary_zh: ToolHazard 提出了一种可扩展的对抗性环境合成框架，用于对集成外部工具的 LLM 智能体进行安全评估与对齐。现有研究主要依赖人工构建或复用环境、基于随机 LLM 的工具模拟以及预定义的注入位置，难以在更广泛领域内开展规模化安全研究。ToolHazard 通过环境模拟器、攻击者智能体和用户模拟器三个核心组件，自动合成可执行的有状态环境，自动发现可行的注入点并生成针对特定环境的 payload，同时构建基于状态的长程任务。基于该框架构建了 ToolHazard-Bench 基准，用于在复杂工作流和多样化环境攻击下对智能体进行压力测试。实验结果表明，智能体存在大量可利用漏洞，且注入时机与位置对攻击效果有显著影响。此外，利用 ToolHazard 生成的对齐数据在 ToolHazard-Bench 和 AgentDojo 上均显著提升了智能体的安全性，同时未损害良性任务的效用。该工作为 LLM 智能体安全提供了可扩展的评测与对齐方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对 LLM 智能体的间接提示注入攻击缺乏规模化评测手段，ToolHazard 提供自动化环境合成与攻击发现框架，帮助安全社区高效发现智能体漏洞并生成对齐数据，对提升智能体鲁棒性有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于 LLM 智能体安全评估、红队测试、安全对齐训练，可扩展至多领域复杂工作流场景。

items.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.summary: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different sessions, users, and models within a provider's ecosystem. We exploit this compatibility to develop a scalable decryption jailbreak. By injecting an encrypted reasoning trace from a given model into a weaker, and less safeguarded model from the same provider, we force it to decode and output the trace verbatim in plaintext, without ever jailbreaking the more capable model directly. This vulnerability enables four distinct attack vectors. First, it circumvents anti-distillation mechanisms, allowing adversaries to extract a proprietary model's reasoning, as we demonstrate across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Second, it allows for large-scale private data extraction. Developers frequently share session logs publicly, unaware of contents of the encrypted blocks. By decoding 315,320 reasoning blocks scraped from public repositories, we recovered 367 Personally Identifiable Information (PII) artifacts and 182 credentials. Third, it inadvertently reveals hazardous information hidden within the reasoning process, even in cases where the model's final, visible output safely rejects a malicious request. Fourth, attackers can leverage this flaw to execute invisible prompt injections, embedding malicious payloads entirely within encrypted blocks to poison public agentic rollouts. Following responsible disclosure, we propose concrete cryptographic and system-level mitigations to secure client-side reasoning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文揭示了领先大模型提供商（如 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google）在客户端加密存储推理轨迹（chain-of-thought）的设计中存在的严重架构漏洞。这些提供商为了隐藏模型逐步推理过程以保护知识产权并限制信息泄露，不是将推理轨迹保存在服务器端，而是将其加密后作为不透明文本块返回给客户端，客户端需在后续请求中原样回传。作者发现，这些加密块在同一提供商的生态系统中具有跨会话、跨用户和跨模型的兼容性与可互换性，攻击者可利用这一点实施可扩展的解密越狱。具体方法是：将从某能力强模型中提取的加密推理轨迹，注入到同一提供商的较弱且防护较少的模型中，强制其解码并以明文形式逐字输出推理内容，从而无需直接攻破强者模型即可获取专有推理。该漏洞衍生出四个攻击向量：其一，绕过反蒸馏机制，成功在 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 上提取专有模型推理；其二，实现大规模私有数据提取，作者从公共仓库抓取的 315,320 个推理块中解码出 367 个个人身份信息（PII）和 182 个凭据，表明开发者公开共享的会话日志可能意外泄露敏感数据；其三，即使模型最终可见输出安全地拒绝恶意请求，其隐藏推理过程仍可能含有危险信息，该漏洞可强制泄露这些信息；其四，攻击者可将恶意负载完全嵌入加密块中，实施不可见的提示注入，毒化基于代理（agentic）的公共部署。论文在负责任披露后，提出了具体的密码学与系统级缓解措施，例如对加密块进行上下文绑定、引入认证加密与完整性校验等。总体而言，该工作揭示了一种影响主流 LLM API 生态的新攻击面，并为防御者提供了重要的研究参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞直接影响主流 LLM API 的保密性和数据安全，可导致专有模型推理泄露、大规模 PII/凭据暴露及隐藏提示注入，破坏依赖 AI 的应用安全性，安全团队应高度关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用客户端加密推理轨迹设计的 LLM 提供商及其下游应用，包括使用公开会话日志的开发者、基于代理的 AI 系统，以及任何依赖加密块进行状态传递的架构。
detection_signals_zh: API 响应中出现异常的明文推理内容，尤其是来自较弱模型却包含强模型特征
同一加密块被重用到不同的会话、用户或模型中
请求中提交的加密块与当前请求上下文不匹配
defense_advice_zh: 对加密推理块实施严格的上下文绑定（如绑定会话、用户、模型版本）
采用认证加密与完整性校验，确保密文不可被跨上下文重用
服务端在接收加密块时验证其来源与合法性
在代理系统中对解密后的内容进行输入验证，不信任任何加密块内嵌指令

items.title: Repeated-Game Security for Restaking-Based Verifiable Inference
items.summary: Restaking-based protocols enable verifiable LLM inference without the high proving cost of zkML or the hardware trust assumptions of TEEs. Their security is commonly justified by a one-round slashing condition: a rational provider should not cheat when the expected penalty exceeds the cost saving from dishonest inference. This paper shows that this condition can overstate security when inference is supplied repeatedly under the same stake. We model verifiable inference as a discounted repeated game and identify a repeated-game gap caused by proportional slashing: detected deviations reduce future penalty exposure, while cost savings are earned again across queries. We derive the gap in closed form, show that it persists under minimum-stake ejection, and extend it to memoryless bounded-slashing protocols covering deployed designs. We propose a deployable mechanism combining history-dependent challenges, reputation-weighted slashing, and stake vesting. The mechanism restores infinite-horizon subgame-perfect incentive compatibility against stationary mixed-strategy deviations above an explicit discount-factor threshold without per-query cryptographic verification. Evaluation across nine open-weight model pairs from 0.5B to 14B parameters shows that the audit signal has the required concave detectability response. A Stackelberg audit-budget analysis shows that improved signal responsiveness reduces the baseline audit rate by 2.6x at discount factor 0.95. Calibrated to deployed parameters, surveyed protocols pass one-round incentive compatibility but admit repeated-game deviations for discount factors between 0.92 and 0.98, with deviation-profit fractions of 1.5%--8%. Our mechanism reduces deviation profits by 31%--54% while maintaining low-latency economic verification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究基于再质押（restaking）协议的可验证大语言模型（LLM）推理安全问题。这类协议通过经济惩罚机制（slashing）取代了 zkML 的高昂证明成本或 TEE 的硬件信任假设，从而以较低成本实现推理的可验证性。现有安全性论证通常依赖单轮（one-round）条件：理性提供者在预期惩罚超过作弊成本节省时不会作弊。然而，本文指出当推理在相同质押下重复进行时，该条件会高估实际安全性。作者将可验证推理建模为折扣重复博弈（discounted repeated game），发现由比例削减（proportional slashing）导致的“重复博弈缺口”：(1) 被检测到的违规会降低未来的惩罚暴露，而 (2) 成本节省会在多次查询中不断累积。论文以闭式形式推导了这一缺口的大小，证明其在最小质押驱逐（minimum-stake ejection）机制下依然存在，并进一步扩展至覆盖实际部署的无记忆有界削减协议。为修复该缺口，作者提出一种可部署机制，结合历史相关挑战（history-dependent challenges）、声誉加权削减（reputation-weighted slashing）和质押归属（stake vesting），在无需逐查询密码学验证的情况下，于显式折扣因子阈值之上恢复无限时域子博弈完美激励相容性（subgame-perfect incentive compatibility），针对平稳混合策略偏离。实验评估覆盖九个从 0.5B 到 14B 参数的开源模型对，表明审计信号具有所需的凹可检测性响应。Stackelberg 审计预算分析显示，在折扣因子 0.95 时，改进的信号响应可将基线审计率降低 2.6 倍。针对已部署参数的校准表明，现有协议通过单轮激励相容性测试，但在折扣因子 0.92–0.98 之间允许重复博弈偏离，偏离利润占 1.5%–8%；而所提机制可将偏离利润降低 31%–54%，同时维持低延迟的经济验证。该研究适用于关注 LLM 推理经济安全、博弈论机制设计及去中心化基础设施的从业者与研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统揭示再质押推理协议的单轮安全论证在重复博弈场景下的漏洞，为设计真正激励相容的验证机制提供理论依据，对依赖经济惩罚的 LLM 服务方和协议开发者具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响采用 restaking 机制进行 LLM 推理验证的协议（如基于 EigenLayer 的方案），可能导致恶意提供者在重复博弈中通过策略性作弊获利，削弱推理完整性保证。

items.title: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on third-party skills, using natural-language descriptions for selection and instruction bodies for planning. This progressive-disclosure design exposes two sequential control points to untrusted publishers: a static skill may steer an otherwise correct task onto an unnecessarily costly trajectory. Prior work studies selection manipulation, malicious skill instructions, and tool-chain resource amplification largely separately, leaving their end-to-end composition unclear. We introduce Convergent Detour Hijacking (CDH), a text-only, runtime-independent attack that couples these stages. Under shared semantic cover, a description establishes relevance during selection, while an aligned body reuses that rationale to fabricate plausible dependencies during planning. CDH attracts an attacker-controlled coordinator alongside legitimate skills, recruits unnecessary benign skills into a bounded detour, and then re-enters the original route to preserve task completion. We evaluate it across multiple LLM backends and 491 held-out tasks under single-task and multi-turn conditions. On DeepSeek-V4-Pro, the matched coordinator is selected in 80.02% of tasks; among coordinator-hit runs that complete tasks, token consumption and end-to-end execution time increase by 66.91% and 92.45%, respectively, while aggregate task completion remains comparable. Thus, correct outcomes do not guarantee trajectory integrity or cost safety.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究基于技能（skill-based）的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在依赖第三方技能时面临的安全风险。现代 LLM 智能体常通过自然语言描述进行技能选择，并使用技能指令体（instruction body）来指导任务规划，这种渐进式披露（progressive-disclosure）设计为不受信任的技能发布者提供了两个顺序控制点：一个静态技能描述可以将原本正确的任务引导到不必要的高成本轨迹上。以往研究分别关注了选择操纵、恶意技能指令和工具链资源放大，但尚未系统分析其端到端组合效果。为此，作者提出了一种名为“收敛绕行劫持”（Convergent Detour Hijacking, CDH）的纯文本、运行时独立的攻击方法，将上述阶段耦合起来。CDH 利用共享语义掩护：技能描述在任务选择阶段建立相关性，而技能体在规划阶段复用该理由来制造看似合理的依赖关系，从而引导模型选择攻击者控制的协调者（coordinator）技能，同时招募多个无害的良性技能进入一个有界绕行路径，随后重新汇入原始任务路线以保证任务最终完成。论文在多个 LLM 后端和 491 个保留任务上进行了单任务和多轮条件评估。实验结果显示，在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上，匹配的协调者技能在 80.02% 的任务中被选中；在协调者命中的完成任务中，token 消耗和端到端执行时间分别增加了 66.91% 和 92.45%，而整体任务完成率几乎不受影响。这表明，即便任务结果正确，也不能保证执行轨迹的完整性和成本安全性。该研究首次系统化展示了技能选择与指令体协同操纵的资源放大攻击面，揭示了 LLM 智能体供应链中隐蔽的拒绝服务/成本型风险，适合 LLM 安全研究员、智能体框架开发者以及安全运营团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统证明 LLM 智能体即使正确完成任务，也可能被第三方技能暗中引导到高成本轨迹，导致 token 和计算资源大幅消耗。这对依赖第三方技能生态的智能体应用构成隐蔽的财务与性能威胁，且难以通过仅检查最终结果发现。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于技能库选择的 LLM 智能体框架，尤其涉及云 API 计费、长时运行任务、多轮交互等场景；可能被用于资源耗尽型经济攻击或干扰服务可用性。
detection_signals_zh: 任务执行轨迹中出现不必要的中间技能调用，且绕行后重新接回原路线
单任务 token 消耗或执行时间出现无明显原因的异常升高（如超过基线两倍）
选中的技能描述与任务语义高度相关但实际执行路径包含冗余步骤
多技能调用中，某些非必要技能在多个任务中反复被共同触发
defense_advice_zh: 在技能选择阶段增加对技能描述与指令体一致性的交叉校验
监控技能调用的复杂度分数，建立 token 消耗和执行时间的基线告警
对第三方技能实施最小权限原则，限制其可引入的其他技能范围
在规划阶段对绕行式依赖链条进行检测，识别重新汇入原路的异常结构
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: How China-Origin Vision-Language Models Move from Refusal to Reframing in State Alignment
items.summary: State-aligned distortion has been documented in China-origin text-based large language models (LLMs), but whether, and in what form, it arises in multimodal systems has not been systematically examined. We construct a balanced benchmark of 200 core entries spanning ten politically sensitive topics, plus a seven-variant visual-abstraction probe, and run nine vision-language models (VLMs), seven China-origin and two non-China, across four elicitation paradigms and two prompt languages, yielding 21,708 trials. Each response is audited on six dimensions -- explicit refusal, information integrity, visual grounding, state-aligned framing, language consistency, and response length -- by two independent frontier LLM judges, validated against three human experts on a 200-trial sample. Measuring each dimension separately lets us decompose multimodal censorship into individual signals rather than a single refusal-based score; in particular, refusal and framing are measured independently, so a model can stop refusing while still reframing. We find that (i) Chinese-language prompting roughly triples the odds of state-aligned framing, within every model; (ii) China-origin models reframe more than non-China models (direction robust across judges and human raters; magnitude 1.6--3.2x); (iii) the effect is strongest in text-only political commentary (36.5%) and is gated by recognition of the depicted subject rather than pixel detail, persisting even at silhouette for iconic images; and (iv) across four Qwen generations, state-aligned framing rises while explicit refusal falls: censorship migrates from a visible act (refusal) to an invisible one (fluent reframing). We argue this shift to invisible reframing is fundamentally a problem of human-AI interaction: it removes the very signal users rely on to recognize that information has been withheld.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统研究了源自中国的多模态视觉-语言模型（VLM）在涉及政治敏感话题时，如何从显式拒绝转向隐性重构（reframing）的状态对齐行为。此前已有研究证明中国原生的文本大模型存在国家对齐的扭曲现象，但多模态系统中的表现尚未被系统检验。作者构建了一个包含200个核心条目的平衡基准，覆盖十个政治敏感主题，并设计了一个七变体视觉抽象探针；对九个VLM（七个中国原生、两个非中国）在四种提示范式和两种提示语言下进行测试，共收集21,708次试验。每个响应由两个独立的前沿LLM裁判在六个维度上审计：显式拒绝、信息完整性、视觉锚定、国家对齐框架、语言一致性和响应长度，并在200个试验样本上与三位人类专家进行验证。通过单独测量每个维度，作者将多模态审查分解为独立信号，而非单一的基于拒绝的得分；特别是，拒绝和框架被独立测量，因此模型可能在停止拒绝的同时仍进行重构。主要发现包括：(i) 在每一个模型内，中文提示使国家对齐框架的出现几率约提高三倍；(ii) 中国原生模型比非中国模型重构更多（方向在不同裁判和人类评分者间稳健，幅度为1.6-3.2倍）；(iii) 该效应在纯文本政治评论中最强（36.5%），且取决于对描绘主体的识别而非像素细节，即使对于标志性图像的剪影也存在；(iv) 在四代Qwen模型中，国家对齐框架上升而显式拒绝下降：审查从可见行为（拒绝）迁移到不可见行为（流畅重构）。作者认为这种向不可见重构的转变本质上是人机交互的问题：它移除了用户赖以识别信息被扣留的信号。该研究为理解多模态模型中的审查机制提供了新视角，并提出了一种分解式测量方法。适合关注AI安全、对齐、内容审查和可信AI的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了多模态模型审查从显式拒绝转向隐形重构的新趋势，这种重构更难被用户察觉，对信息透明度和人机信任构成威胁。安全从业者需关注此类对齐行为对内容审核和合规检测的挑战。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响AI内容安全检测、模型审计和合规评估。可迁移至任何评估多模态模型政治偏见或审查行为的场景，尤其是跨语言提示和视觉抽象变化下的行为分析。

items.title: The Next Challenge for Agentic Cybersecurity: A Realistic, Contamination-Free Reverse Engineering Benchmark
items.summary: AI agents are rapidly improving in cybersecurity capabilities when the source code is available for analysis, yet much of the software most consequential to cybersecurity, including malware, firmware, and proprietary applications, is available only as binaries. Analyzing such software requires reverse engineering(RE): recovering program semantics before the analysis can be meaningfully performed. However, evaluating agentic RE poses a fundamental challenge: benchmark instances must be unseen as source code in the LLMs' training data to prevent models from taking shortcuts by recognizing them rather than really analyzing them, while also matching the scale and anti-analysis protections of real software. Unfortunately, however, existing benchmarks do not jointly satisfy these requirements. To this end, we introduce SRE-Bench, the first realistic, contamination-free RE benchmark. Built entirely from scratch by RE experts with over 5,000 hours, SRE-Bench comprises 19 private, real-world-scale programs averaging 16.9K lines of code. We further developed 44 in-house anti-analysis primitives, yielding 262 binary instances and 1572 deterministically graded tasks. Our evaluation across five frontier LLMs (GPT-5.6-sol,Claude-Opus-5,GPT-5.5,Grok-4.5, and GLM-5.2) shows that RE remains largely unsolved: the strongest model, GPT-5.6-sol, scores 61.4% per instance, and fully solves only 31.5% of the instances. Our analysis further reveals that agents behave differently from human engineers, where agents are relatively insensitive to compiler optimization and static linking. Controlled ablations also confirm that both contamination control and realistic scale are essential. These results indicate that strong source-code security capabilities do not yet transfer to binary analysis, highlighting RE as an important frontier for agentic cybersecurity and SRE-Bench as a rigorous testbed to measure progress.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一个针对智能体网络安全的新挑战：目前 AI 智能体在源代码可用场景下的安全能力提升迅速，但现实中大量关键软件（如恶意软件、固件、专有应用）仅以二进制形式存在，需要先进行逆向工程（RE）恢复程序语义才能进一步分析。然而，评估智能体的逆向工程能力存在根本性矛盾：基准测试样例必须未在 LLM 训练语料中作为源代码出现过，防止模型通过记忆识别而非真实分析来走捷径；同时又需要匹配真实软件的规模与抗分析保护。现有基准均无法同时满足这两个需求。为此，作者构建了 SRE-Bench——首个现实、无污染的逆向工程基准。该基准由逆向工程专家投入超过 5000 小时从零构建，包含 19 个私有、真实规模的程序，平均每份代码约 16.9K 行；团队还开发了 44 个自研抗分析原语，最终生成 262 个二进制实例和 1572 个确定性评分任务。作者对五个前沿 LLM（GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-Opus-5、GPT-5.5、Grok-4.5、GLM-5.2）进行评估，结果显示逆向工程仍然基本未解决：最强的模型 GPT-5.6-sol 每个实例得分为 61.4%，且仅完全解决 31.5% 的实例。进一步分析发现智能体的行为与人类工程师不同，对编译器优化和静态链接相对不敏感。受控消融实验也证实，污染控制和真实规模都至关重要。这些结果表明，强大的源代码安全能力尚未迁移到二进制分析领域，凸显逆向工程是智能体网络安全的重要前沿，而 SRE-Bench 可作为衡量进展的严谨测试平台。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了当前 LLM 智能体在真实二进制逆向工程上的能力缺口，为蓝队评估 AI 助手在恶意软件分析、固件审计等场景下的实际可用性提供了重要参考，并首次提供无污染、真实规模的基准。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该基准可迁移到恶意软件分析、固件漏洞挖掘、专有软件审计等实际防御场景，也能帮助安全团队判断智能体工具在二进制层面是否值得信任。

items.title: AI Guardrail Survival under Single-Cycle Agentic Self-Summarization
items.summary: Long-running agents periodically compact their context, replacing the transcript with a model-generated summary.Recent work shows that dropping a standing safety constraint during compaction drives behavioral violations acrossmany models (Governance Decay; Chen, 2026). We ask a finer question: under a single compaction cycle, how is a safetyrule lost, and what does that imply for detection and evaluation? Our central finding is that a presence check is not asafety check: when compaction does not drop a rule outright, it often leaves something that looks like a rule but doesnot act like one. On behavioral replay, a degraded residue leads the model to perform the prohibited action far more oftenthan an intact welded rule does (all-case gaps of +34 and +57 points under two replay models, both positive), category-level survival behaves like a residue, and even intact rules sometimes fail to fire, so an audit that checks only textualpresence gives false assurance. Sharpening this, rule-form items are retained substantially more often than prominence-matched facts, which is exactly why presence-based checking feels adequate even though survival is not protection.Textual loss is regime-dependent (weld-or-drop with a single rule; degraded predicate-loss residues under a tighterbudget), and we did not observe the hypothesized textual severing mode. Such loss is silent at runtime and detectableonly by comparison with retained external ground truth (such as a constraint registry), which reveals textual absence butnot whether a surviving rule still fires. We also document evaluation pitfalls where LLM-judge labels alone would havereversed a conclusion. All results concern a single compaction cycle.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究长期运行的智能体（agent）在上下文压缩（context compaction）过程中，安全规则（safety rule）如何丢失或退化。以往研究（如 Governance Decay）表明，在压缩时直接丢弃安全约束会导致多种模型出现行为违规；本文则聚焦于单次压缩周期内，安全规则丧失的微观机制及其对检测与评估的启示。核心发现是：存在性检查（presence check）不等于安全性检查——压缩即使未直接删除规则，也常留下“看似规则但不起作用”的退化残留（residue）。通过行为回放（behavioral replay）实验，作者发现：退化残留导致模型执行被禁止行为的频率显著高于完整保留的规则（两种回放模型下差距分别为+34和+57个百分点），类别层面的规则存活表现出类似残留特征，甚至完整规则有时也无法触发，因此仅检查文本存在性的审计会给人虚假的安全感。进一步分析表明，规则形式的条目被保留的概率远高于同等显著性的普通事实，这解释了为何基于存在性的检查看似充分，但存活并不等于保护。文本丢失呈现制度依赖性（单条规则时为“焊接或丢弃”模式，预算紧张时出现谓词丢失的退化残留），未观察到假设的“文本切断”模式。这种丢失在运行时是静默的，只有通过与外部真实约束源（如约束注册表）对比才能检测到文本缺失，但无法判断存活的规则是否仍能触发。作者还记录了评估陷阱：仅依赖 LLM 作为裁判得到的标签可能反转结论。所有结果均基于单次压缩周期。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对LLM智能体上下文压缩这一实际工程场景，揭示基于文本存在性的安全审计存在盲区，对构建可靠的Agent安全监控与评估体系有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用上下文压缩机制的长周期LLM智能体系统（如对话代理、自动化任务代理），并影响依赖LLM裁判做安全评估的流程。
detection_signals_zh: 压缩后规则文本仍存在但行为违规率升高
规则谓词被退化或改写导致触发条件改变
仅靠文本存在性检查无法发现规则失效
defense_advice_zh: 定期用行为回放测试验证规则是否真正触发，而非仅检查文本存在
建立外部约束注册表，与压缩后的上下文进行对比
对LLM裁判的评估结论进行交叉验证，避免单一标签误判
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: An Empirical Study of Output-to-Input Loops for Black-Box Backdoor Detection in Fine-Tuned Open-Weight LLMs
items.summary: Anyone can upload a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) to a public repository and claim it is safe. A backdoored model behaves normally on ordinary inputs until a hidden trigger fires, and a user with no training data, clean reference weights, or the trigger phrase has no clear way to check the model before using it. We introduce and empirically evaluate self-feeding, a black-box test method that feeds a model's own output back as its next input, so the text drifts away from the starting prompt and toward the data the model was fine-tuned on. We test self-feeding against a repeated same-prompt baseline on six open-weight LLMs (3B-15B parameters), each fine-tuned with backdoors spanning eleven attack categories, using twenty ordinary starting prompts and chains of up to ten steps. Self-feeding finds backdoors in five of six models at 92.0\% pooled precision, while the same-prompt baseline succeeds on only one of 120 prompt-model pairs; chains that begin with a joke request, an arithmetic question, or a coffee recipe all reach a trigger within a few steps. Recall per prompt is low (19.2\%), and we show why it still adds up to much higher detection at the model level once several starting prompts are used. We also report where the method falls short: one model was never triggered, and self-feeding produced two false positives that the same-prompt baseline cannot produce. Cutting the chains to four steps keeps every model-level detection at 100\% precision while using 60\% fewer queries. Needing only text-level query access and a way to recognize malicious output, self-feeding offers a cheap first check on a downloaded model.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究微调开源权重大语言模型（LLM）中的后门检测问题。在公共模型仓库中，任何人都可以上传微调后的模型并声称其安全性，而带有后门的模型在普通输入下表现正常，直到触发隐藏触发器。用户在缺乏训练数据、干净参考权重或触发短语的情况下，几乎无法在使用前验证模型安全性。为此，作者提出并实证评估了一种名为 self-feeding 的黑盒检测方法：将模型自身的输出作为下一次输入反馈，使生成文本逐渐偏离起始提示，并趋向该模型微调时所使用的数据分布。实验基于 6 个开源权重 LLM（参数规模 3B-15B），每个模型植入涵盖 11 个攻击类别的后门，使用 20 个普通起始提示并迭代最长 10 步。结果表明，self-feeding 在 5/6 的模型上以 92.0% 的合并精确率检测出后门，而重复同一提示的基线仅在 120 个提示-模型对中成功 1 次；以笑话请求、算术问题或咖啡配方起始的链路通常能在几步内触发后门。虽然每个提示的召回率较低（19.2%），但使用多个起始提示可在模型级别显著提高检测概率。方法也存在局限：有 1 个模型始终未被触发，且 self-feeding 产生 2 个基线无法产生的假阳性。将链路截短至 4 步可在模型级 100% 精确率的前提下减少 60% 查询开销。结论是，self-feeding 仅需文本级查询访问和识别恶意输出的能力，为下载模型提供了一种廉价的首轮安全筛查手段。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 微调模型的后门攻击对 LLM 供应链安全构成实际威胁。现有检测方法往往需要训练数据或权重访问，而 self-feeding 仅以黑盒文本查询即可运行，显著降低检测门槛，可作为部署前快速筛查的实用工具，增强公共模型生态系统信任。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何下载并使用微调开源 LLM 的场景，尤其是集成到 Agent、聊天机器人等应用时的安全评估，也可迁移到 API 托管模型的可疑行为检测，但需结合其他方法降低误报率。
detection_signals_zh: 模型在自反馈循环中生成与上下文无关的特定领域文本
输出文本逐步偏离初始提示，进入明显不相关的语义主题
较长的反馈链路中出现重复或奇怪的固定短语
defense_advice_zh: 在部署微调模型前，使用 self-feeding 方法进行低成本筛查
对模型输出进行自动或人工审核，识别触发后门时的异常模式
与多种黑盒检测基线结合，以降低假阳性和假阴性
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Backdoor Decontamination Dynamics in LLM Agents
items.summary: Open-weight LLM agents are vulnerable to backdoors installed during fine-tuning, which may be undetectable if the trigger conditions are never met during testing. Assuming defenders do not know the existing trigger, they cannot unlearn it directly. One decontamination strategy is to install a known backdoor (defensive poisoning) then to unlearn it, hoping that the original unknown backdoor is removed as a side effect. However, this procedure has uncertain outcomes: the original backdoor may persist or be erased or rerouted, among other possibilities. We introduce a framework for studying these dynamics in tool-calling agents, decoupling trigger, response, teacher, and fine-tuning method across systematic experiments on AgentDyn. Across 115 experiments, defensive poisoning alone erases around 56% of original backdoors; subsequent decontamination then drives almost all survivors to erasure, confirming that trigger recognition and malicious execution are behaviorally dissociable. Interestingly, our experiments find that malicious backdoors never persist when using different triggers of the same general type as the defensive backdoor when followed by decontamination via unlearning. Co-installing up to four backdoors increases resistance (around 36% erased), yet decontaminating a single known co-resident backdoor collaterally clears 52/60 co-residents (87%). Upon visualizing postdecontamination model internals using J-lens, we confirm that although the decontamination restores benign LLM responses, traces of original trigger awareness persist at intermediate layers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究开源权重 LLM 智能体在后门注入后的净化（decontamination）动态问题。攻击者可通过微调在模型中植入后门，且触发条件在测试阶段可能永远不会被满足，导致传统评测无法发现。防御者通常不知道原始触发条件，因此无法直接进行反学习（unlearn）。一种可行的净化策略是：先主动安装一个已知后门（称为防御性投毒），再对该已知后门进行反学习，以期附带清除原始未知后门。然而，此过程存在不确定性：原始后门可能被保留、被消除或发生重定向。论文提出了一个统一框架，用于研究工具调用类 LLM 智能体中的这些动态行为，将触发条件、响应行为、教师模型和微调方法进行解耦，并在 AgentDyn 基准上开展系统性实验。研究共进行了 115 组实验，主要发现包括：仅进行防御性投毒可消除约 56% 的原始后门；随后引入净化操作可以使几乎所有存留的后门被清除，表明触发识别与恶意执行在行为学上是可分离的。当防御性后门与原始后门使用同类型但不同的触发条件时，经过净化后，恶意后门从未保持持久性。同时安装多达四个后门会增加抗净化能力（仅约 36% 被清除），但对单个已知共存后门进行净化可附带清除 52/60（87%）的共存后门。利用 J-lens 可视化净化后的模型内部状态，发现即便净化恢复了良性响应，中间层仍保留了原始触发感知的痕迹。该工作为理解 LLM 智能体后门净化的内在机制提供了实证基础，并揭示了防御性投毒与反学习策略的有效性和局限性。适合 LLM 安全研究者、AI 红队与蓝队成员以及从事 AI 供应链安全的工作者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 开源模型微调后门难以察觉且不易清除，该研究首次系统性量化了“防御性投毒+反学习”净化策略的消除率与残留风险，为蓝队评估模型供应链安全性、设计后门缓解流程提供了可操作的实验依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用开源权重 LLM 作为工具调用智能体的场景，例如自动化运维代理、代码助手、企业级 LLM 应用。其净化策略的有效性受后门共存数量、触发类型等因素影响，且净化后内部痕迹仍可能被探测，可迁移到模型安全审计与红队测试的方法论中。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
items.summary: The dominant paradigm treats AI safety as a property to be instilled during model training via RLHF, DPO, or Constitutional AI. We argue this is structurally insufficient for autonomous agents that execute code, mutate files, send messages, and modify databases. Agent safety should be a runtime contract enforced by the harness, and the contract has two complementary faces. The preventive face blocks dangerous actions before they happen via sandboxes, permission gates, output filters, and trajectory monitors. The evidential face requires verifiable proof that good actions actually happened, gating task submission on hard evidence such as test runs, log captures, file diffs, and citation grounding. We ground the position in four lines of public evidence, with row-level protocols and data released in the supplementary JSON files: a survey of 52 documented AI-agent and LLM safety incidents, a false-completion audit with 31 non-contested core cases plus one disputed illustrative case, a trajectory-schema audit of 12 public agent systems and harnesses, and a title-level audit of all 28,560 papers accepted at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR 2023-2025 showing a pooled 8-12x imbalance between training-time and deployment-time publication. Two prior communities that needed to enforce safety, computer security and the experimental sciences, converged on runtime contracts with both preventive and evidential elements; agentic AI is now under the same pressure. We formalize an Agent Trajectory Schema and Evidence Chain, state a compositional gating proposition based on standard monitor composition, and outline a research agenda. The right unit of safety in agentic AI is the trajectory-with-checkable-evidence, not the model.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对当前 AI 安全范式提出根本性挑战。主流方法（如 RLHF、DPO、宪法式 AI）在训练阶段将安全作为模型属性注入，但论文认为对于能够执行代码、修改文件、发送消息、操作数据库的自主智能体，这种训练时安全在结构上不足。作者主张，智能体安全应转变为由执行环境（harness）强制实施的“运行时契约”，并包含两个互补维度：预防性维度（通过沙箱、权限门、输出过滤器和轨迹监视器在动作发生前阻断危险行为）和证据性维度（要求任务提交必须附带可验证的硬证据，如测试运行、日志捕获、文件差异和引文定位，以证明良好行为确实发生）。为支撑这一立场，论文提供四条公开证据线：对 52 起已记录的 AI 智能体/LLM 安全事故的调研；一次虚假完成审计（31 个非争议核心案例加 1 个争议说明案例）；对 12 个公开智能体系统和 harness 的轨迹架构审计；以及对 NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR 2023-2025 年共 28,560 篇论文的标题级审计，显示训练时与部署时论文数量存在 8-12 倍的不平衡。论文还指出计算机安全和实验科学这两个社区均已在运行时契约上收敛，同时包含预防与证据元素，智能体 AI 正面临同样压力。作者进一步形式化了“智能体轨迹模式”和“证据链”，提出基于标准监控器组合的组合式门控命题，并规划研究议程。最终结论是：智能体 AI 的安全单位应是带可检查证据的轨迹，而非模型本身。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该观点将智能体安全从训练时属性转向运行时监控与验证，为蓝队和 SOC 提供了可操作的防护思路，即通过沙箱、权限门和证据链来约束 LLM 智能体的行为。安全工程师可借鉴此框架评估现有智能体系统。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响自主智能体系统、AI 辅助开发、自动化运维等场景；其证据链概念可迁移至安全审计、合规取证和可解释 AI 领域。

要求任务提交附带可验证证据

items.title: On Understanding, Identifying, and Mitigating Vulnerabilities in Agentic Large Language Models
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have undergone a shift from stateless conversational interfaces to autonomous agents capable of multi-step planning, tool invocation, code execution, and maintaining persistent memory. When these agents operate with real-world privileges---calling APIs, modifying files, and querying databases---a compromised reasoning step can trigger unauthorized data access, irreversible state changes, or cascading failures, yet the security research community has not kept pace. To quantify the state of the field, we conducted a systematic literature review under PRISMA 2020 guidelines across six databases, screening 743 records and retaining 85 papers (2023--2025) on agentic LLM security. Attack research outpaces defense work by 3.9:1. Perception-layer vulnerabilities (prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial perturbations) dominate, accounting for 66\% of papers, while action-layer vulnerabilities (tool misuse, code injection, sandbox escape) appear in only 4.7\%, misaligned with real-world risk. Code execution security accounts for 3.5\%, and tool-augmented agents 12\%. We contribute a four-layer taxonomy mapping 13 vulnerability types across perception, brain, action, and interaction layers, and identify seven open problems centered on containment. Agentic LLM insecurity stems from architectural coupling, where weak isolation allows vulnerabilities to propagate across layers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇针对智能体大语言模型（Agentic LLM）安全性的系统性文献综述。研究背景在于，大语言模型已从无状态的对话接口演进为具备多步规划、工具调用、代码执行和持久记忆能力的自主智能体。当这些智能体以真实权限运行——如调用API、修改文件或查询数据库时，一个被攻击者诱导的推理步骤就可能引发未授权数据访问、不可逆状态变更或级联故障，但安全研究社区对这一新兴风险关注不足。为量化该领域研究现状，作者遵循PRISMA 2020指南，在六个数据库中系统筛选了743条记录，最终保留2023至2025年间发表的85篇关于智能体LLM安全的论文。分析显示，攻击研究数量是防御工作的3.9倍；感知层漏洞（包括提示注入、越狱、对抗扰动）占据主导，出现在66%的论文中，而行动层漏洞（如工具误用、代码注入、沙箱逃逸）仅占4.7%，与现实世界风险不成比例。代码执行安全占3.5%，工具增强智能体占12%。作者贡献了一个四层分类体系，涵盖感知、大脑、行动和交互层，映射了13种漏洞类型，并指出了围绕“遏制”的七个开放问题。文章认为，智能体LLM不安全性的根源在于架构耦合——弱隔离使得漏洞能够跨层传播。该综述适合安全研究人员、智能体开发者及风险管理人员阅读，有助于理解当前研究分布、识别薄弱环节并确定未来防御工作的优先方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体LLM正快速融入真实业务系统，但其安全研究严重滞后。本综述揭示攻击研究远超防御的失衡现状，并指出行动层漏洞被严重低估，为蓝队和开发者在设计智能体时提供了关键的威胁建模依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响智能体框架的安全设计、工具调用权限控制、代码执行沙箱等场景；为安全社区提供了漏洞分类和未来研究路线图。

items.title: From Prompt Injection to Web Exploitation: Revisiting Classic Vulnerabilities in LLM-Integrated Applications
items.summary: Large Language Models are increasingly integrated into web applications through chatbots, tool-calling pipelines, and agentic workflows. In these systems, user input may influence not only generated text, but also backend actions such as database queries, HTTP requests, file operations, template rendering, or API calls. This paper introduces LLM-mediated web attacks, a class of attacks in which attacker-controlled input is transformed by an LLM-integrated application and then reaches traditional web-application sinks. We systematize this attack surface through representative LLM2X variants, including LLM2SQLi, LLM2XSS, LLM2SSTI, LLM2CommandInjection, LLM2IDOR, LLM2CSRF, LLM2XXE, and LLM2SSRF. Our analysis shows that the LLM usually does not create the underlying vulnerability itself; rather, it acts as a mediation layer, and in some tool-enabled settings as a confused deputy, carrying attacker influence into components that trust model-generated or model-influenced content. As an experimental case study, we implement TicketOracle, a Flask-based LLM-integrated web application for evaluating LLM2SSRF across five attack scenarios and seven LLMs. Our results show substantial variation in susceptibility across models, suggesting that exploitation depends both on insecure application architecture and model-specific behavior. We conclude with mitigation strategies across the prompt, model, application, and network layers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）集成到 Web 应用后引入的一类新型安全风险，称之为“LLM 介导的 Web 攻击”（LLM-mediated web attacks）。随着聊天机器人、工具调用流水线和智能体工作流日益普及，用户输入不仅影响模型生成的文本，还可能通过后端动作影响数据库查询、HTTP 请求、文件操作、模板渲染或 API 调用等。作者系统化地梳理了这一攻击面，提出了 LLM2X 系列变体，包括 LLM2SQLi、LLM2XSS、LLM2SSTI、LLM2命令注入、LLM2IDOR、LLM2CSRF、LLM2XXE 和 LLM2SSRF 等。核心观点是：LLM 通常并非漏洞的根本制造者，而是充当“中介层”，在某些工具启用的场景下成为“混淆代理”（confused deputy），将攻击者的影响力传递到那些信任模型生成或受模型影响内容的组件中。作为实验案例，作者实现了 TicketOracle，一个基于 Flask 的 LLM 集成 Web 应用，用于在五个攻击场景和七个 LLM 上评估 LLM2SSRF。结果显示，不同模型对攻击的敏感度差异很大，表明利用既取决于不安全的应用程序架构，也取决于模型的具体行为。最后，作者从提示、模型、应用和网络四个层面提出了缓解策略。该研究为理解 LLM 集成应用中经典 Web 漏洞的重新出现提供了系统化视角，适合 LLM 应用开发者、安全研究员和渗透测试人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 集成应用日益普遍，但传统 Web 漏洞可能在 LLM 中介作用下重新泛滥。本文系统化梳理了 LLM2X 攻击面，帮助蓝队和安全工程师理解这类新风险，并强调模型行为与架构缺陷共同决定可利用性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有将 LLM 作为中介的 Web 应用、聊天机器人、Agent 工作流，特别是在工具调用场景下可能放大传统 Web 漏洞（SQL 注入、XSS、SSRF 等）的影响面。

items.title: Generating Attacks for LLMs with GFlowNets
items.summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has facilitated their ubiquitous integration into various domains, leading to widespread adoption. However, this escalating trend has introduced significant security vulnerabilities, necessitating the identification and mitigation of flaws arising from malicious exploitation. Red teaming assessments, conducted to evaluate model robustness through diverse adversarial inputs, are essential for exposing security risks and implementing countermeasures. Currently, red teaming is performed either manually by experts or automatically using predefined attack datasets. Nevertheless, manual testing remains time-consuming, while existing automated methods suffer from limited creativity due to their inherent dependency on fixed datasets. In this study, we propose an automated, human-independent, and adaptive approach leveraging GFlowNets to identify LLM vulnerabilities by utilizing one large language model to test another. Within this framework, an attacker model is trained against a specified victim model to perform automated red teaming and provide a quantitative robustness score. This research aims to generate more effective adversarial attacks in English compared to existing benchmarks and, as a novel contribution to the literature, introduces a model capable of generating attack inputs in the Turkish language.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文提出了一种基于生成流网络（GFlowNets）的自动化红队测试方法，用于发现大型语言模型（LLM）的安全漏洞。研究背景是：随着LLM被广泛集成到各类应用中，其面临的安全威胁日益严重，需要对模型进行鲁棒性评估。传统的红队测试依赖人工专家或预定义的攻击数据集，人工测试耗时耗力，而基于固定数据集的自动化方法缺乏创造性和适应性。为此，作者设计了一个无需人工干预的自适应框架，利用一个LLM作为攻击者来测试另一个目标LLM。具体而言，攻击者模型通过GFlowNets训练，能够针对指定的受害者模型生成多样化的对抗性输入，并输出一个量化的鲁棒性评分。该方法的创新点在于：1）相比现有基准，能够生成更有效的英文对抗攻击；2）作为文献中的新颖贡献，首次引入了能够生成土耳其语攻击输入的模型。实验部分验证了该方法在攻击有效性上优于已有基准，并展示了在不同语言上的扩展能力。这项工作为自动化红队测试提供了新思路，有助于提升LLM的安全性评估效率和覆盖面。适合AI安全研究人员、红队工程师以及关注LLM安全性的开发人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM的自动化红队测试当前依赖固定数据集，缺乏创造性；本工作利用GFlowNets实现自适应攻击生成，可帮助蓝队更高效地发现模型漏洞，尤其是支持多语言（土耳其语）攻击，扩大了安全评估的覆盖面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到其他生成式模型的鲁棒性评估，或集成到CI/CD流水线中持续检测LLM漏洞；对多语言场景下的安全测试有参考价值。

items.title: ColluSkill: Adversarial Cross-Skill Composition for Evading Agent Skill Scanners
items.summary: Agent skills are emerging as an important attack surface in LLM-based agent systems. Through an empirical study of existing skill scanners, we find that current defenses mainly inspect individual skills, leaving risks from cross-skill composition insufficiently examined. This creates a practical blind spot: multiple locally plausible skills may pass security checks while collectively forming a harmful workflow during agent execution. To investigate this threat, we propose ColluSkill, a collusive multi-skill-chain attack framework that decomposes a complete malicious intent into interdependent sub-payloads embedded in independently packaged skills. The attack does not rely on any single malicious skill, but emerges from the ordered composition of locally plausible behaviors through contextual dependencies, artifact passing, and execution handoffs. ColluSkill further employs LLM-based chain planning and scanner-feedback refinement to preserve chain-level attack semantics while reducing suspicious signals in individual sub-skills. To defend against such attacks, we propose ChainGuard, a context-aware skill-chain scanner that jointly analyzes a candidate skill and the skills already installed in the agent environment. ChainGuard reconstructs cross-skill dependencies, artifact flows, capability compositions, and downstream behaviors to identify risks that emerge only at the workflow level. Experiments on six representative skill scanners show that ColluSkill achieves an average attack success rate of 96.0% and consistently outperforms the evaluated single-skill and multi-skill attack baselines. Meanwhile, ChainGuard reduces the attack success rate to 22.5% while allowing 99.5% of benign workflows to pass, highlighting the importance of chain-level security analysis for agent skill ecosystems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了基于LLM的智能体系统中，通过多技能组合规避现有技能扫描器的攻击方法。现有安全扫描器主要逐个检查单个技能，忽略了多个技能组合后形成的整体风险，导致攻击者可以将一个恶意意图分解为多个看似无害的子技能，每个技能独立通过检查，但在执行时按顺序组合形成恶意工作流。作者提出了一个名为ColluSkill的对抗性多技能链攻击框架，该框架将完整恶意意图分解为相互依赖的子载荷，并嵌入到独立打包的技能中。攻击不依赖任何单一恶意技能，而是通过上下文依赖、工件传递和执行交接，从局部看似合理的行为的顺序组合中涌现出来。ColluSkill还利用基于LLM的链规划和扫描器反馈优化，在保持链级攻击语义的同时减少单个子技能中的可疑信号。为了防御此类攻击，作者提出了ChainGuard，一种上下文感知的技能链扫描器，它联合分析候选技能和智能体环境中已安装的技能，重建跨技能依赖、工件流、能力组合和下游行为，以识别仅在工作流级别出现的风险。在六个代表性技能扫描器上的实验表明，ColluSkill的平均攻击成功率为96.0%，持续优于评估的单技能和多技能攻击基线；而ChainGuard将攻击成功率降至22.5%，同时允许99.5%的良性工作流通过，凸显了链级安全分析对智能体技能生态系统的重要性。该研究为智能体安全提供了一个新的攻击视角和防御框架，建议安全从业者关注技能组合的潜在风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现有LLM智能体安全防御多聚焦单技能检测，但本研究发现恶意意图可被拆解为多个合法技能，组合执行形成攻击。这揭露了一个实际盲区，提醒蓝队需要从工作流层面审视技能安全，不可依赖单点扫描。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用独立技能包构建工作流的LLM智能体系统，攻击者可能通过组合技能绕过现有安全审核，导致恶意操作在运行时浮现。ChainGuard提供缓解思路。

单个技能表面风险低，但其执行顺序组合后可形成高风险行为
技能间的调用链跨越多个独立包且具有复杂上下文关联
defense_advice_zh: 采用上下文感知的技能链扫描，联合分析候选技能与已安装技能
对技能间工件流和调用依赖进行重建与审计
对工作流级行为进行动态沙箱验证，而非仅静态单点检查

items.title: RangeFactory: Scalable Construction of Multi-Hop Cyber Ranges
items.summary: Real-world cyberattacks often require sustained progress across multiple hosts and network segments, making multi-hop cyber ranges essential infrastructure for studying and improving LLM agents' ability to sustain complete attack chains. Prior work has scaled isolated vulnerability tasks and constructed multi-host scenarios from manually specified vulnerability semantics. However, they are still unable to automatically orchestrate the growing supply of vulnerability environments into end-to-end validated multi-hop ranges. To this end, we present RangeFactory, an automated cyber-range orchestration framework that constructs multi-hop cyber ranges at scale from isolated vulnerability environments. RangeFactory formulates range construction as dependency resolution: it extracts dependency information from agents' actual attacks against real vulnerabilities, resolves known dependencies through template-guided orchestration, and uses end-to-end attack execution to validate runtime dependencies that emerge after composition. Using RangeFactory, we construct RangeBench with 1,148 validated range instances spanning 287 distinct attack chains and evaluate frontier attack agents across attack depth, network scale, and task information. Among runs that compromise the entry vulnerability, 24.5-47.0% still fail to complete the remaining attack path, revealing a substantial sustained-compromise gap between establishing an initial foothold and completing a multi-hop attack. RangeFactory further produces a corpus of 5,541 outcome-annotated multi-hop attack trajectories, providing execution data for attack-process analysis and future agent training.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 真实网络攻击通常需要跨多个主机和网段的持续渗透，因此多跳网络靶场（multi-hop cyber range）是研究和提升大语言模型（LLM）智能体完成完整攻击链能力的关键基础设施。已有工作扩展了孤立漏洞任务，并基于人工指定的漏洞语义构建多主机场景，但仍无法自动将日益增长的漏洞环境组合编排为端到端验证的多跳靶场。针对这一空白，本文提出 RangeFactory——一个自动化网络靶场编排框架，能够从孤立的漏洞环境大规模构建多跳靶场。RangeFactory 将靶场构建形式化为依赖解析问题：它从智能体针对真实漏洞的实际攻击行为中提取依赖信息，通过模板引导的编排解析已知依赖，并利用端到端的攻击执行来验证组合后出现的运行时依赖。基于 RangeFactory，作者构建了 RangeBench，包含 1,148 个经过验证的靶场实例，覆盖 287 条不同的攻击链，并评估了前沿攻击智能体在攻击深度、网络规模和任务信息等方面的表现。在成功攻破入口漏洞的运行中，仍有 24.5%–47.0% 未能完成后续攻击路径，揭示了从建立初始立足点到完成多跳攻击之间存在显著的持续攻陷能力差距。此外，RangeFactory 还产出了包含 5,541 条带结果标注的多跳攻击轨迹语料库，为攻击过程分析和未来智能体训练提供了执行数据。该研究主要贡献包括：提出自动化靶场编排框架、构建大规模基准 RangeBench、揭示现有 LLM 智能体在多跳持续攻击中的不足，并公开可用的轨迹数据。适合关注 LLM 安全评估、自动化渗透测试和网络靶场建设的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次实现从孤立漏洞到大规摸多跳靶场的自动化构建，揭示了 LLM 智能体在初始突破后持续攻击能力不足的关键差距，为评估和训练更强大的攻击型智能体提供基础设施和基准数据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LLM 智能体安全评估框架、自动化渗透测试工具开发，以及网络靶场自动化建设领域；产出的轨迹数据可用于攻击行为研究与防御训练。

items.title: ActBench: Self-Evolving Benchmark of Behavioral Safety in Cowork Agents
items.summary: Cowork agents may complete benign tasks while disclosing protected data, manipulating unauthorized state, invocate unauthorized API. We define behavioral safety and introduce ActBench, a self-evolving benchmark that evaluates such behavior risk from execution trajectories rather than final responses. Each case pairs a benign task with an adversarial variant that preserves its instruction, configuration, initial state, rating model, and trusted records while injecting a task-reachable payload. ActBench contains 600 cases from 213 scenarios, spanning 15 risk behaviors, six execution spaces, and 48 web-service APIs.To move beyond static payloads, we propose a reward-guided beam search method that jointly optimizes attack effectiveness and task utility, while reflection diagnoses failed execution checkpoint and guides payload revision. Besides, we propose a dual evidence verification mechanism that verifies agent execution safety and utility through log evidence and LLM-based trajectory evidence.We evaluate 15 LLMs and 6 open-source cowork agents over 24,000 trajectories. Under a fixed harness, attack success rates ranges from 10.1% to 94.4% across models, while under a fixed base model, they range from 73.7% to 94.4% across agents.These results show greater variation across models than agent harness, while attacks remain highly successful across all tested harnesses.Our benchmark is released at: https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并评估了一个名为 ActBench 的自进化基准，用于衡量协作智能体（cowork agents）的行为安全性。研究背景是：协作智能体在完成看似良性的任务时，可能泄露受保护数据、操纵未授权状态或调用未授权的 API，这类风险难以通过传统仅检查最终回答的评测来发现。因此，作者定义了“行为安全”（behavioral safety），并重点分析智能体在执行轨迹中的风险，而非最终答案。ActBench 的每个测试用例由一个良性任务和一个对抗性变体组成，后者保留了原任务的指令、配置、初始状态、评分模型和可信记录，同时注入一个任务可达的恶意载荷。基准包含来自 213 个场景的 600 个用例，覆盖 15 类风险行为、6 种执行空间和 48 个 Web 服务 API。为突破静态载荷的局限，论文提出一种奖励引导的束搜索方法，联合优化攻击有效性与任务实用性，并通过反思机制诊断失败执行检查点、指导载荷修订。同时，提出一种双证据验证机制，利用日志证据和基于 LLM 的轨迹证据来验证智能体的执行安全性和实用性。作者评估了 15 个 LLM 和 6 个开源协作智能体，跨越 24,000 条轨迹。在固定基准框架下，跨模型的攻击成功率从 10.1% 到 94.4% 不等；在固定基础模型下，跨智能体框架的成功率从 73.7% 到 94.4% 不等。结果表明，模型之间的差异大于智能体框架之间的差异，但攻击在所有测试框架上仍高度成功。该基准已开源。

items.title: Beyond Direct Identifiers: Probabilistic Privacy Risk Estimation for Privacy-Conscious LLM Query Delegation
items.summary: Recent work on protecting privacy during user-LLM interactions often focuses on direct, explicit identifiers: the personally-identifiable information (PII) captured by standard detectors. One such approach is Privacy-Conscious Delegation (PCD), where a local LLM acts as an intermediary. However, privacy risk does not stem solely from explicit identifiers but also PII-free self-disclosures, leaving users identifiable through combinations of quasi-identifying traits. We investigate a probabilistic variant of PCD, where we augment its objectives with an LLM-driven probabilistic estimation of k-anonymity. To facilitate this, we first create the PUPA-SD dataset, which contains naturalistic user queries with self-disclosure. Our preliminary results indicate that optimizing PAPILLON on PUPA-SD improves quality on unseen conversations across a variety of local models and produces the best privacy-utility balance for Llama-3.2-3B, while smaller models struggle to jointly optimize quality and privacy. We propose k-anonymity as a useful auxiliary metric for tackling PCD.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对用户与大语言模型（LLM）交互过程中的隐私保护问题展开研究。现有的隐私保护方法通常只关注直接的显式标识符，即标准检测器能捕获的个人身份信息（PII），例如姓名、邮箱、电话等。然而，隐私风险并不仅仅源于显式标识符，还包括不含PII的自我披露（self-disclosures），这些信息可以通过准标识符（quasi-identifying traits）的组合重新识别出用户身份。论文在隐私意识委托（PCD）框架下提出概率变体，PCD是一种让本地LLM作为中介来代理用户查询的方法，以避免原始查询直接暴露给服务端。作者在该框架中引入由LLM驱动的k-匿名性概率估计，并作为优化目标的一部分。为支持该研究，作者创建了PUPA-SD数据集，其中包含带有自我披露的自然用户查询。基于该数据集，他们优化了名为PAPILLON的方法。初步实验表明，在PUPA-SD上优化的PAPILLON在多种本地模型上的未见对话质量均有提升，并且在Llama-3.2-3B上取得了最佳的隐私-效用平衡；而较小的模型难以同时优化生成质量和隐私保护。此外，作者提出将k-匿名性作为辅助度量标准，以更好地评估和指导PCD方法。该研究为LLM查询委托中的隐私风险评估提供了新思路，强调了超越简单PII检测的隐私保护需求。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统隐私保护仅依赖PII检测，忽略了准标识符组合带来的重新识别风险。该研究提出基于k-匿名性的概率隐私风险评估，能更全面地衡量LLM查询委托的隐私泄露，对部署本地LLM中介服务的场景具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到涉及用户数据脱敏、匿名化处理的LLM服务场景，例如隐私合规的智能助手、云端LLM代理等；也可用于改进隐私保护算法的评估指标。
defense_advice_zh: 建议隐私保护框架在过滤显式PII之外，还需评估准标识符的联合分布，采用k-匿名性作为辅助度量
优化本地LLM的隐私-效用平衡，避免过度匿名化导致服务质量下降

items.title: Toward Metacognitive One-Shot Indirect Prompt Injection: Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection
items.summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which malicious instructions embedded in external observations manipulate subsequent agent decisions and actions. Most existing adaptive attacks rely on repeatedly querying and refining against the target agent, whereas realistic attackers may have only a single opportunity to interact with an unknown target agent. We propose SAVOR (Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection), which shifts attack adaptation from test-time iteration to offline strategy distillation. SAVOR performs outcome-conditioned reflection over successful and failed trajectories collected from disjoint training environments, validates context-conditioned candidate strategies, and iteratively consolidates them into a reusable strategy memory. At test time, the frozen memory guides the generation of a single payload for each unseen target, requiring only one target-agent query and no target-agent feedback. Across two benchmarks and three victim models, SAVOR attains the highest average attack success rate in all six settings, leading the strongest prior attack by 2.5 to 11.8 points and the same injection channel without strategy learning by 23.1 points on Agent Security Bench, which holds out attacker tools, and 28.6 points on OpenClaw-IPI, an executable benchmark we introduce that holds out attack goals and verifies attacks through tool interactions and execution receipts. A memory learned under one defense also transfers to another.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对工具型大语言模型（LLM）智能体面临的间接提示注入（IPI）威胁展开研究。IPI 指攻击者将恶意指令嵌入外部观察数据中，从而操纵智能体的后续决策与行为。现有自适应攻击大多依赖对目标智能体进行反复查询和调整，但现实攻击者可能只有一次交互机会，且目标智能体通常是未知的。为此，作者提出 SAVOR（Strategy Abstraction Via Outcome-Conditioned Reflection）方法，将攻击适应性从测试时迭代转变为离线策略蒸馏。SAVOR 在多个不相交的训练环境中收集成功与失败的轨迹，通过结果条件反射对候选策略进行验证，并迭代合并为可复用的策略记忆。测试阶段，该记忆以冻结状态指导生成针对每个未见目标的单一负载，仅需一次目标查询，无需任何目标反馈。作者在两个基准和三个受害者模型上进行了评估，SAVOR 在全部六种设置中均取得最高平均攻击成功率，领先最强已有攻击 2.5 至 11.8 个百分点。在 Agent Security Bench 上，相比无策略学习的同一注入通道，SAVOR 提升了 23.1 个百分点；在作者新引入的 OpenClaw-IPI 可执行基准上，该基准隔离了攻击目标并通过工具交互和执行回执验证攻击，SAVOR 提升了 28.6 个百分点。此外，实验表明在一种防御下学习到的策略记忆可以迁移到另一种防御。该研究揭示了单次、无反馈条件下实施 IPI 攻击的现实可行性，对 LLM 智能体的安全性评估与防御设计具有重要参考价值。适合关注 LLM 智能体安全、提示注入攻击与防御的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次展示了仅凭单次查询即可在不同目标上实现高成功率间接提示注入，突破了以往需要反复交互的假设，对 LLM 智能体安全评估与防御策略有直接影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有工具型 LLM 智能体场景，包括自主代理、浏览器助手、RAG 系统等；其策略记忆可迁移性意味着攻击可能跨系统复用，扩大了威胁面。
defense_advice_zh: 对输入外部数据进行严格的来源标记和语义隔离，降低恶意指令被解释为系统指令的风险。
实施最小权限原则，限制智能体可调用的工具和可执行的操作，降低注入成功后造成的损害。
在关键决策点引入人类审批或交叉验证机制，尤其是对高影响操作。

items.title: SkillsMetric: Mapping the Detection Boundary of Static Analysis for Malicious Agent Skills
items.summary: Agent Skills---structured packages of instructions and scripts that augment LLM-based agents---are rapidly proliferating, yet their security properties remain under-explored. We present \textsc{SkillsMetric}, a five-stage static analysis framework that scores skill packages along pattern density, statistical anomaly, dataflow taint, import anomaly, and capability mismatch dimensions. We construct an adversarial evaluation dataset of 2{,}266 skills spanning 16~attack types across code-level, system-level, and semantic-level threats, and evaluate on the full SkillMD-138K corpus. Our framework achieves an AUC of 0.93 and 5-fold cross-validated F1 of 73.4\%$\pm$0.5\%, with strong detection of data exfiltration (93\%) and steganographic payloads (93\%). Crucially, we identify fundamental blind spots: \emph{host destruction} attacks using common shell commands evade all five stages (0\% detection), and \emph{prompt injection} via natural-language manipulation achieves only 42\% detection. These findings establish that static analysis alone is insufficient for skill security, motivating defense-in-depth architectures that combine fast static pre-screening with semantic review.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 SkillsMetric——一个面向 LLM Agent 技能包（Agent Skills）的静态分析安全评估框架。技能包是以结构化指令和脚本形式扩展大模型智能体能力的新兴载体，其安全属性尚未被充分研究。SkillsMetric 采用五阶段静态分析：模式密度、统计异常、数据流污点、导入异常、能力不匹配，对技能包进行综合评分。作者构建了一个包含 2,266 个对抗性技能样本、覆盖 16 种攻击类型（涵盖代码级、系统级和语义级威胁）的评测数据集，并在完整的 SkillMD-138K 语料库上评估。实验表明该框架的 AUC 为 0.93，5 折交叉验证 F1 为 73.4%±0.5%，其中对数据外泄（93%）和隐写载荷（93%）有较强检测能力。然而，作者也揭示了根本性盲区：利用常见 shell 命令的主机破坏攻击在所有五个阶段均无法检出（0% 检出率），而通过自然语言操纵实现的提示注入仅有 42% 的检出率。这些发现证明，仅靠静态分析不足以保障技能包安全，应构建结合快速静态预筛选与语义审查的纵深防御架构。该研究对 LLM Agent 安全、恶意技能包检测及安全架构设计有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM Agent 技能包快速普及，但安全评估工具缺失。SkillsMetric 首次系统量化了静态分析的检测边界，揭示其对主机破坏和提示注入的盲区，直接驱动纵深防御设计，对安全工程师评估 Agent 供应链风险具有实际指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用 Agent 技能包机制的 LLM 应用，尤其涉及外部插件、市场下载或用户自定义技能的场景；检测缺口可被恶意技能包利用，导致数据窃取、系统破坏或权限提升。方法可迁移至其他基于静态信号的恶意代码检测场景。

items.title: What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable? Evidence from 138K SKILL.md Files
items.summary: Under the current standard, Agent Skills are SKILL.md files that combine instructions with supporting resources, enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures beyond a single conversation. Yet many public skills appear to originate from a single task, repository, or conversation, even when they are shared as reusable components. We analyze this gap across 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy grounded in the official specification and best-practice guidance. We find that 91.8% of skills contain at least one detected defect, with stable estimates across lenient and strict thresholds (88.8-94.6%). The dominant failures are ordinary packaging problems rather than exotic attacks: weak routing metadata, bloated or non-actionable bodies, and poor resource organization. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills shows the functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved more reliably from startup descriptions than skills with routing defects. Defect rates vary by platform and provenance: specification-aware skills contain fewer defects, while AI-marked skills show more safety and portability problems. Lightweight enforcement and repair experiments support a quality-assured generation workflow combining spec-aware prompting, lightweight linting, automated repair, and safety gating.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对当前 Agent Skills 标准下可复用性问题进行了大规模实证研究。Agent Skills 通常以 SKILL.md 文件形式存在，将指令与辅助资源结合，使大型语言模型（LLM）代理能够在单次对话之外复用流程。然而，许多公开的技能虽然以可复用组件形式分享，实际上往往源于单一任务、单一仓库或单一对话，缺乏真正的通用性。作者收集了来自 20,556 个仓库的 138,133 个公开 SKILL.md 文件，基于官方规范和最佳实践指南构建了一个两层缺陷分类体系，系统性地分析了这些技能文件的质量。研究发现，91.8% 的技能文件至少包含一个检测到的缺陷，且在宽松和严格阈值下估计结果稳定（88.8%-94.6%）。主要的失败类型是常规的打包问题而非恶意攻击：包括路由元数据薄弱、正文臃肿或不可操作、资源组织混乱等。作者进一步对 20,000 个技能执行确定性路由压力测试，结果显示具有有效路由元数据的技能从启动描述中被检索的可靠性显著高于存在路由缺陷的技能。缺陷率在不同平台和来源间存在差异：遵循规范的技能缺陷较少，而带有 AI 标记的技能在安全性和可移植性方面问题更多。最后，论文提出了轻量级强制与修复实验，验证了一种质量保证生成工作流，该工作流结合了规范感知提示、轻量级 lint 检查、自动修复和安全门控。该研究为 Agent Skills 的可复用性提供了大规模数据支撑，为技能开发者和平台设计者提供了改进方向。适合关注 LLM 代理生态、技能工程和安全质量的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次对大规模公开 Agent Skills 进行系统性质量分析，揭示绝大多数技能存在影响复用的缺陷，为 LLM 代理生态的安全与可靠性提供了数据依据，有助于推动技能标准化和质量保障。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面覆盖所有使用 SKILL.md 标准的 LLM 代理框架，如 AutoGPT、Claude Skills 等。缺陷可能导致技能检索失败、误用，甚至潜在的安全风险（如资源混乱引入恶意内容）。研究提出的缺陷分类可迁移到其他类似声明式组件（如插件、工具描述）的质量评估。

items.title: Withholding the Completing Chunk: Deterministic Pair-Completion Guardrails for Streaming LLM Output
items.summary: Streaming language-model output creates a release-timing problem: complete-response moderation acts after streamed text has escaped, whereas repeated semantic classification of partial text can be costly and unstable. We study a narrow deterministic construction in which each committed danger signature is the conjunction of two lexical predicates. The guard scans the accumulated prefix before every release and withholds the first chunk that makes both predicates observable. Across four signature families, eight chunk sizes, and 32 mechanism trials, streaming decisions matched the buffered scanner and withheld every pair-completing chunk; eight single-predicate controls passed. In a separate 512-trial strategy comparison, full-prefix scanning and complete buffering detected all configured pairs, a 512-character window detected 96/128, and chunk-local scanning detected 38/128. Fixed pairs flagged 0/338 human-derived safe responses and detected 0/394 jury-labelled unsafe responses, confirming narrow rather than general harm coverage. A calibrated official Llama Guard 3 1B baseline classified 310/338 safe responses as safe and 202/394 unsafe responses as unsafe. Repeated-prefix scanner time on 16,384-character responses ranged from 13.261 ms to 829.640 ms across tested chunk sizes. Pair completion is therefore an exact release-boundary backstop for a small fixed policy, not a substitute for semantic moderation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对流式大语言模型（LLM）输出审核中的“发布时序”问题展开研究。在流式场景下，若等到完整响应生成后再进行安全审核，危险文本已经逃逸给用户；若对不完整片段反复进行语义分类，则计算成本高且结果不稳定。为此，作者提出一种确定性的窄范围防护结构：将每个需要拦截的危险签名定义为两个词法谓词的合取（例如“包含A且包含B”），守卫程序在每次向用户释放新的文本块之前，扫描当前已累积的前缀，一旦发现某个块使得这两个谓词同时变为可观察，就扣留该块，从而在精确的边界上阻止危险内容完成。作者设计了系统的实验验证：在4个签名族、8种块大小、共32次机制试验中，该流式决策结果与“先缓冲再整体扫描”的基准完全一致，成功扣留了所有“补全对”的块；而仅使用单个谓词的对照组则全部放行。在512次策略对比试验中，全前缀扫描和完整缓冲能检出全部配置的签名对；512字符滑动窗口检出96/128；仅基于当前块的局部扫描检出38/128。在真实数据上，固定签名对在338条人工确认的安全响应中产生0次误报，在394条标注为不安全的响应中也检出0条，说明其覆盖范围非常狭窄而非通用危害检测。作为对比，经过校准的Llama Guard 3 1B基准确将310/338安全响应分类为安全，将202/394不安全响应分类为不安全。性能方面，对16384字符响应进行重复前缀扫描的开销在13.261毫秒至829.640毫秒之间，取决于块大小。该工作的核心贡献是为小型固定安全策略提供了一种精确的释放边界后盾机制，计算开销可控且可确定性地执行，但它并不能替代语义级审核。适合对流式LLM输出安全、实时内容过滤机制感兴趣的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 流式LLM输出的实时审核是实际部署中的难点，现有方案要么滞后要么成本高。本文提出一种确定性、低开销的机制，可作为语义审核的补充，尤其适用于已知危险模式的精确拦截。对于构建LLM服务的安全团队有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于流式生成场景中的敏感信息拦截、关键词组合过滤等；但覆盖范围有限，不能作为唯一防线。
defense_advice_zh: 对于已知的危险模式，可在流式输出中实现确定性的前缀扫描并扣留补全块；但需注意其窄覆盖，必须与语义审核结合。

items.title: SIPSorcery: Malformed UDP datagram crashes TurnServer receive loop with no restart, disabling TURN UDP relay for all clients (DoS)
items.summary:
## Summary
`TurnServer.ReceiveUdpAsync` places its generic `catch (Exception)` OUTSIDE the `while` receive loop, and `Start()` launches the loop fire-and-forget with no supervision or restart. A single pre-authentication UDP datagram whose STUN header first byte is in `0x80–0xFF` causes `STUNHeader.ParseSTUNHeader` to throw `ApplicationException`, which unwinds past the loop and terminates it. The TURN UDP relay is then dead for ALL clients until the process is restarted.

## Root Cause
`src/SIPSorcery/net/TURN/TurnServer.cs`:
- `ReceiveUdpAsync` (:555-577): the inner `try` (:562-567) wraps only `_udpSocket.ReceiveAsync()`; `HandleUdpDatagram(result.Buffer, result.RemoteEndPoint)` (:569) is inside the `while` body but OUTSIDE that inner try. The generic `catch (Exception ex)` (:573) is lexically OUTSIDE the `while`.
- `Start()` does `_ = ReceiveUdpAsync();` (:381) — fire-and-forget, no restart.
- `HandleUdpDatagram` (:579) calls `STUNMessage.ParseSTUNMessage(data, data.Length)` (:600) for any non-ChannelData datagram; `ParseSTUNMessage` (STUNMessage.cs:94) has no try/catch.

## Impact
`ApplicationException` propagates out of the `while`, is caught at :573, logged, and the method returns. `_running` remains true but nothing re-invokes `ReceiveUdpAsync` → TURN UDP relay permanently unavailable for all clients (whole-server DoS). Pre-authentication: STUN parsing precedes any TURN allocation/credential check.

## Proof of Concept
Send one UDP datagram to the TURN port (default 3478) with first byte `0x80` (e.g. `80 00 00 00`). `0x80 & 0xC0 = 0x80 ≠ 0x40` → not ChannelData → `ParseSTUNMessage` → `ParseSTUNHeader` executes `if ((Array[startIndex] & 0xC0) != 0) throw new ApplicationException(...)` (STUNHeader.cs:169-172); `0x80 & 0xC0 = 0x80 ≠ 0` → throws.

## Attack Chain
1. Entry: one UDP datagram to the TURN port, first byte `0x80–0xFF`. Guard: ChannelData branch requires `(data[0] & 0xC0) == 0x40` (:583). Bypass: `0x80 & 0xC0 = 0x80 ≠ 0x40` → falls through to `ParseSTUNMessage` (:600).
2. Sink: `STUNMessage.ParseSTUNMessage` → `STUNHeader.ParseSTUNHeader` (STUNHeader.cs:169-172) throws `ApplicationException`. Guard: none before the throw; `ParseSTUNMessage` has no try/catch. Bypass: `0x80 & 0xC0 = 0x80 ≠ 0` → throws.
3. Impact: exception unwinds past the `while` into `catch(Exception)` at :573 → logged → method returns → loop exits. Guard: none — no restart (`Start()` :381 fire-and-forget). Bypass: N/A. TURN UDP relay dead for all clients until process restart.

## Bypass Evidence
- Loop/catch structure: catch at TurnServer.cs:573 is outside the `while` at :559; `HandleUdpDatagram` at :569 is outside the inner try (:562-567).
- Unguarded `ParseSTUNMessage` at :600; throw at STUNHeader.cs:169-172.
- Fire-and-forget start at :381 with no restart in `Start()`.
- `TurnServerConfig.ListenAddress` defaults to `IPAddress.Loopback` (:42), but a functioning TURN server must bind a routable address to serve clients, so real deployments are exposed. Non-default config narrows the vulnerable population, not the attack difficulty → AC:L.

## Affected Versions
`nuget:SIPSorcery <= 10.0.13` (TurnServer component present since 10.0.5; verified on release tag v10.0.13 and HEAD).

## Dedup
NOT a duplicate of GHSA-28gm-jrmw-xx93 (CVE-2026-54632), which covers the client RTP/ICE socket (`UdpReceiver`/`RTPChannel`). `TurnServer` is a distinct shipped RFC 5766 server component with its own loop and fix location.

## Suggested Fix
Wrap `HandleUdpDatagram` in a per-datagram try/log-and-continue INSIDE the `while` (matching the drop-and-continue intent of fix bdb76cb), and/or add loop supervision/restart.

---
Reported by **zx (Jace)** — GitHub: @manus-use

items.title: Towards Scalable Fuzzy PSI via Efficient Fuzzy Matching
items.summary: In this paper, we present scalable fuzzy PSI protocols for general $L_{p \in [1, \infty]}$ distance, supporting both low- and high-dimensional sets. The core technique is two efficient fuzzy matching protocols. The first is built from a role-reversed oblivious PRF (OPRF) and realizes $O(d\log δ)$ overhead, compared to $O((\log δ)^d)$ in previous works. The second leverages customized oblivious transfer (OT) with $O(d\ell)$ overhead, where $\ell$ is the bit length of inputs, which is particularly suitable for short inputs. With these new techniques, we further propose a new dual-layer hashing framework for fuzzy PSI over low-dimensional sets, instantiated with our OT-based fuzzy matching and enhanced with a domain reduction optimization. The protocols achieve an overhead linear with $n, m, \log δ, 2^d$, without the $O((\log δ)^d)$ or $O(δ)$ factors present in prior works. {For high-dimensional sets, we construct fuzzy PSI protocols based on our OPRF- and OT-based fuzzy matching, which achieve an asymptotic overhead linear with $n, m, d$, and $\log δ$ but rely on the strong globally disjoint assumption.} Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our protocols achieve up to a $145\times$ speedup in running time and a $20\times$ reduction in communication cost compared to van Baarsen and Pu~(ASIACRYPT'25), and achieve up to a $25\times$ speedup in running time and up to a $17\times$ reduction in communication cost compared to Piske et al.~(CCS'25).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在隐私保护计算领域，私有集合交集（PSI）允许两方在不泄露非交集元素的情况下求出交集。然而，传统PSI要求元素完全一致，而实际应用中往往需要匹配相似而非相同的元素，因此模糊PSI（Fuzzy PSI）应运而生。已有模糊PSI方案在高维或大集合上开销巨大，如计算复杂度随维度指数增长。本文提出了一系列可扩展的模糊PSI协议，支持一般的L_p距离（p∈[1,∞]），适用于低维和高维集合。核心创新在于两种高效的模糊匹配协议：第一种基于角色反转的不经意伪随机函数（OPRF），实现了O(d log δ)的开销，而以往方案为O((log δ)^d)；第二种利用定制的疏忽传输（OT），开销为O(dℓ)，其中ℓ为输入比特长度，特别适合短输入。基于这些技术，作者进一步提出了双层层哈希框架，专门用于低维集合的模糊PSI，结合了基于OT的模糊匹配和域缩减优化。整体协议的开销与集合大小n、m以及log δ、2^d成线性关系，消除了以往方案中的O((log δ)^d)或O(δ)因子。对于高维集合，作者构建了基于OPRF和OT的模糊PSI协议，渐近开销与n、m、d和log δ线性，但依赖于强全局不相交假设。大量实验表明，与ASIACRYPT'25和CCS'25的最新方案相比，运行时间最多加速145倍，通信成本最多降低20倍，展现显著性能优势。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 模糊PSI是实现隐私保护数据匹配的关键技术，可用于威胁情报共享、联系人发现、基因相似度匹配等场景。本文大幅降低计算与通信开销，使得在低资源环境下部署模糊PSI成为可能，对推动隐私计算实际应用具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 性能提升可推广到任何需要安全近似匹配的应用，如安全多方计算中的相似性搜索、私有联邦学习中的样本对齐等。
defense_advice_zh: 关注该协议的实现细节，在实际使用时需评估安全假设（如高维集合的全局不相交假设）是否满足，并针对具体参数进行安全配置。
